body:
## What it does

Instead of a long backlog it comes back with a handful of features worth building, each already named, plus the things it thinks you should drop. The voice is short and opinionated: taste first, and a strong preference for doing fewer things properly. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @poteto shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
